Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned AGA for the State.
2.

This writ petition is preferred praying for the following principal relief:
"1. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus to direct the respondents to arrest the accused/respondent no. 4 in pursuance of FIR dated 03.10.2024 as Case Crime No. 0154 of 2024, u/S 452, 376, 504, 506 I.P.C., P.S. -
Meerapur, District- Muzaffarnagar."

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner vehemently contended that even though the impugned FIR has been lodged way back on 3.10.2024 but till date there is no progress in the investigation.
He states that initially the petitioner has moved an application u/s 156(3) Cr.P.C. for registration of the FIR but the same was rejected vide order dated 18.10.2023.
Against the said order, the petitioner filed criminal revision, which was also rejected.
The said order was challenged before this Hon'ble Court in Matters Under Article 227 No. 7661 of 2024.

Learned Single Judge vide order dated 16.7.2024 has allowed the writ petition setting aside the order impugned the matter was remitted back to the court concerned to pass an appropriate order in accordance with law.
In response thereof, the impugned FIR has been lodged.
It is stated that fair investigation is not being conducted on account of influence exercised by the accused persons.
As such, the direction may be issued to the respondents to ensure free and fair investigation expeditiously.
4. Learned AGA, on the other hand, states that the investigation is in progress and some further time may be accorded to seek appropriate instructions.

5. In the facts of the case, no fruitful purpose would be served keeping the writ petition pending for consideration and on consent, we dispose of the writ petition with an observation that a fair and impartial investigation must be concluded in the instant matter, in accordance with law,
expeditiously, preferably within a period of two months from the date of presentation of a certified copy of this order.

Order Date :- 6.2.2025 A.K.Srivastava  Mausmeen vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110735595/
